disclaimer: This tracker records public evidence. It does not infer a root cause when the available evidence does not establish one.

issues.title: Persistent Recon markers
issues.summary: Developers acknowledged persistent Recon marker reports, shipped improvements in Patch 1.3, and continued monitoring because exact reproduction remained difficult.

issues.title: Robotic / distorted Proximity VOIP
issues.summary: The team reported work with its external VOIP partner and said a candidate fix had produced positive initial results, but the exact failing component was not publicly established.

issues.title: AMD-associated crash reports
issues.summary: Developers described several stability problems occurring more frequently on AMD hardware and cautioned against treating all AMD crashes as one defect.

issues.title: Extended / invisible collision reports
issues.summary: Patch 1.3 documents many map fixes including extended collision. Individual community reports must not be assumed to be the exact assets covered by those fixes without direct linkage.

issues.title: Community-server VIP list removed by reset
issues.summary: Patch 1.3 explicitly states that resetting a community server no longer removes its VIP list. This confirms the defect class, but not the cause of every historical SoulSniper VIP incident.

incidents.title: Community-server incident template
incidents.note: An incident is an observed operational event. Do not convert a plausible association into a cause without evidence.
